data.name: LeaseRenewalFailedAlertSubject
data.value: The licence lease could not be renewed

data.name: LeaseRenewalFailedAlertBody
data.value: The panel has failed to renew its licence lease {0} times in a row ({1}). The lease it holds keeps paid modules covered until it ends; after that they stop working until a renewal succeeds. Check that this server can reach the licence service, or contact the issuer of your licence.

data.name: LeaseRenewalReasonUnreachable
data.value: the licence service could not be reached

data.name: LeaseRenewalReasonRefused
data.value: the licence service refused to issue a lease

data.name: LeaseRenewalReasonAnswerRejected
data.value: the licence service's answer was not a valid lease for this licence

data.name: LeaseRenewalReasonNotNewer
data.value: the licence service returned a lease that does not extend the current one

data.name: LeaseRenewalReasonWriteFailed
data.value: the lease could not be stored on this server

data.name: LeaseRenewalRecoveredAlertBody
data.value: The panel renewed its licence lease after repeated failures. Paid modules are covered again for the whole life of the new lease.

data.name: LicenceExpiryAlertBody
data.value: The installed licence expires on {0} (days left: {1}). Add-on modules stop working when it expires; the modules included with the panel are not affected. To renew, open Settings, then Licence, and claim the licence again for this server on the marketplace, or install a new licence file.
